resources.string: Sign in to GitHub, Codeberg or your own Forgejo to read and clear what needs you.

Forgeline checks your Inbox in the background. Allow notifications to hear about mentions and reviews.
Sign in to GitHub, Codeberg or your own Forgejo to see what they star, fork and release.
Activity from the people you follow and the repositories you watch shows up here.
Private repositories are out of reach
This sign-in to %1$s only covers public repositories. Sign in again to open your private ones, and to comment, star and run workflows there.
GitHub will ask for access to your repositories, private ones included. Forgeline needs it to show them, and to comment, star and run workflows there.
GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg or your own Forgejo. Your inbox and feed need an account; Trending and browsing work without one.
Forgeline talks to %1$s directly from your phone. Your token is encrypted on this device and only ever sent there.
Any Forgejo server works with an access token.
Any GitLab server works with an access token.

To sign in through the browser instead of a token, create an application on your server (Preferences, then Applications): redirect URI http://127.0.0.1/oauth/gitlab, not confidential, scopes api and read_user. Then paste its Application ID here.
Create a classic token with the notifications, read:user, user:follow and repo scopes, then paste it here.
Create a personal access token with the api and read_user scopes, then paste it here.
Create an access token that reaches all your repositories (public, private and limited), with read and write access to notifications, repositories, issues and your user, then paste it here.
Waiting for you to authorize Forgeline on GitHub…

See one account at a time, or all together
Instead of the list published for everyone each day
Nobody publishes this server\'s Trending: measure it on this phone

Once a day, the phone reads the server\'s most-starred repositories and its newest forks, and keeps their star counts. Stars gained show from the second day; weekly and monthly lists fill in over 7 and 30 days. A small server takes a few requests.
GitHub has its own Trending, and Codeberg\'s and GitLab\'s are published for everyone each day. Sign in to Codeberg or another Forgejo server to measure theirs on this phone instead.

Time to undo an Inbox action
Each Inbox check also loads what waits on you, so it opens at once. Off saves data and requests.
Follow what was done on the forge’s site

A thread read or marked done on GitHub, Codeberg or GitLab’s own site leaves the Inbox here too. Forges don’t say which of the two happened, so both count as done. Off, those threads stay in All as read.
